newsitem.title: INDONESIA: TUNAS FINANCE UNIT TO OFFER 50 MLN SHARES.
newsitem.headline: TUNAS FINANCE UNIT TO OFFER 50 MLN SHARES.

text.p: Indonesia's automobile finance firm PT Tunas Finance, a unit of automobile distributor PT Tunas Ridean, will offer a 30 percent stake to the public later this year, company officials said.
"Tunas Finance plans to offer some 50 million shares to the public sometime in November or December this year to expand business," corporate secretary Miranti Andiyana told Reuters.
Miranti declined to give further details of the planned floatation.
She said Tunas Finance posted a net profit of 11.5 billion rupiah in 1996 against 8.3 billion rupiah in 1995.
